more_info.banned_in:
Approved in the EU.
Approved in the US.
US food use is subject to the listed CFR provisions and their conditions, checked in 2026.
more_info.overview: Acesulfame potassium is the potassium salt of acesulfame, a high-intensity sweetener approximately 200 times as sweet as sucrose. It provides sweetness when added to the food or used in a table-top sweetener preparation. The specified material is supplied as white powder or crystalline material. The specification identifies water solubility as one of its properties.
more_info.uses:
Examples in the EU food-use list include certain cocoa and Chocolate products as covered by Directive 2000/36/EC; other confectionery including breath freshening microsweets; chewing gum; decorations, coatings and fillings, except fruit-based fillings covered by category 4.2.4; fruit nectars as defined by Directive 2001/112/EC and vegetable nectars and similar products; flavoured fermented milk products including heat-treated products.
The entries apply to particular food categories and may limit the amount, the preparation or the way it is used; they do not show how often the additive appears in retail products.
more_info.side_effects:
Assessed food-use exposure was generally below the limit.
EFSA identified a possible genotoxic manufacturing impurity and requested a tighter limit or additional data.
